svg.title: OX-55 loaded olive pack UI artwork proposal
svg.desc: Matched reference captures show the First City baseline and olive canopy. The debug-only bundled BASELINE proof choice is compared with the loaded olive pack while preserving the same selected weather and timeline; normal First City remains unchanged.
